The gitleaks allowlist regex for the truncated PEM stub (a base64 stub and literal dots) that the ctxdex hook test feeds. Its text holds a regex-escaped backslash, an n, a word and an escaped dot, which the UNC rule reads as a server and a share; it is regex source, not a network path. Shape cannot tell a regex escape from a real share, so the exemption is this one line and not a looser rule: a real share on any other line or in any other file still fails, and the entry goes stale (and fails) if the line is removed.
